title: Wireframes That Show Learning Logic
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting wireframes that show learning logic to the annotated wireframe with per-region learner-action and sequence-phase labels, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the annotated wireframe with per-region learner-action and sequence-phase labels shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
